description:
An immaculately presented first floor apartment conveniently situated in the town centre and cultural quarter of Northampton offering an ideal investment opportunity with an anticipated rental income of £775 pcm, share of the freehold and vacant possession.

Location - Hazelwood Road is situated in a central Northampton location, within the NN1 postcode district and the Castle ward.  The immediate surroundings include Castilian Street, Castilian Terrace, Derngate, St Giles Street and Spring Gardens, placing Hazelwood Road within a well-established central urban neighbourhood.

A key advantage of the location is its proximity to Northampton town centre, providing convenient access to shops, restaurants, cafés, leisure facilities and employment opportunities. The area also benefits from being close to Northampton General Hospital and the University of Northampton, making it attractive to both professionals and students. Overall, Hazelwood Road can be described as a well-connected town-centre residential location, offering good access to Northampton's central amenities and major local institutions.

Accommodation- First Floor - The Bauhaus was converted from Victorian town house in 2015, comprising of seven apartment in the town centre, a communal hall serves all apartments with an intercom entry system.The apartment has a hall which has a useful store cupboard and modern wood flooring which continue to all rooms apart from the shower room which is tiled.

The lounge has a sash window to the front aspect and incorporates the kitchen which comes with a range of modern cabinets, timber work tops incorporating a sink unit, hob and oven with extractor hood, further more there is a built in fridge and recently installed freestanding washer/dryer and feature exposed brickwork.
 
The bedroom overlooks the rear and has a walk in wardrobe, a stylish shower room is completely tiled and has a shower cubical, wash hand basin and wc.

Furthermore, there is a useful store cupboard on the half landing.

Leasehold Details - Each apartment enjoys a share of the freehold and a lease term of 999 years from 2015  with a monthly service charge of £95.

Fixtures And Fittings - Only those items in the nature of fixtures and fittings mentioned in these particulars are included in the sale. Other items are specifically excluded. None of the appliances have been tested by the agents and they are not certified or warranted in any way.

Services - None of the services have been tested and purchasers should note that it is their specific responsibility to make their own enquiries of the appropriate authorities as to the location, adequacy and availability of mains water, electricity, gas and drainage services.

Agents Note - Additional information about the property, including details of utility providers, is available upon request. Please contact the agent for further details.
